course.title: Elements of Civil Engineering Structures
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A concrete beam with a rectangular section 300 mm wide and 500 mm deep is prestressed by 2 post-tensioned cables of area 600 mm² each. Initially stressed to 1600 N/mm². The cables are located at a constant ecentricity of 100 mm throughout the length of the beam having a span of 10 m. The modulus of elasticity of steel and concrete is 210 and 38 kN/mm², respectively-
i. Neglecting all losses, find the deflection at the centre of span when it is supporting its own weight.

ii. Allowing for 20% loss in prestress, find the final deflection at the centre of span when it carries an imposed load of 18 kN/m. $\mathsf { D } _ { \mathsf { c } } = 2 4 \mathsf { k N } / \mathsf { m } ^ { 3 }$

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
